passwordRules.title: Your password must:

rule.variety: Mix at least {{kinds}} of these — or be {{passphrase}}+ characters of any kind:
rule.common: Not be a common password, like password123 or 12345678
rule.patterns: Have no keyboard runs (qwerty, 12345), no character {{repeat}}+ times in a row, and at least {{distinct}} different characters
rule.personal: Not contain your name or email address
rule.spaces: Not start or end with a space
rule.history: Not be one of your last {{n}} passwords (checked when you save)
rule.lettersDigits: Both letters and numbers (not needed at {{passphrase}}+ characters)
rule.sequence: No {{run}} numbers in a row counting up or down (like 1234 or 9876)

passwordRules.tip: Tip: a short sentence you will remember, like “Mango tree near well 7”, is strong and easy to type on a phone.
passwordRules.easy: This password is easy to guess. It is allowed, but a longer one — or one with a capital letter or a symbol — keeps your mothers' records safer.
passwordRules.tipSimple: Tip: a word you will remember and a few numbers, like “Mango4729”, is easy to type on a phone.
